title: Mega-Sena 3064 rolls over and jackpot reaches 75 million
seoTitle: Mega-Sena 3064 rolls over: jackpot reaches 75 million
subtitle: Draw held in São Paulo left the main prize without winners and increased the rollover jackpot.
excerpt: Mega-Sena draw 3064, held on October 29, had no winners in the main tier, pushing the prize up to R$ 75 million, with numbers released and.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Mega-Sena draw 3064 was drawn on the night of October 29 at Espaço da Sorte in São Paulo and had no winners in the main tier. Therefore, the R$ 49.5 million prize rolled over, rising to R$ 75 million for the next draw.

Draw and rollover jackpot

The draw took place at 9 p.m. (Brasília time) and, according to Caixa Econômica Federal, the estimated prize for anyone matching all six numbers was R$ 49.5 million. Since no one won, the amount rolled over, becoming available for the next draw.

Numbers and prizes

A total of 82 bets with five matches were announced, receiving R$ 24,039.44 each, and 4,467 bets with four matches, which took home R$ 727.39 each. The division of the gross prize follows the rule of 40% for the Sena, 13% for the Quina, and 15% for the Quadra.

How to bet

The minimum bet costs R$ 6 and can be placed until 8 p.m. at any lottery outlet, on the website, or via the Loterias Caixa app. Digital group bets can be purchased until 8:30 p.m., exclusively through the Loterias Online portal and the app. Online payment accepts PIX, credit card, or internet banking for Caixa account holders.

Odds and prize tiers

For a simple six-number bet, the probability of winning the Sena is 1 in 50,063,860. Bets can be made with up to 20 numbers, increasing the chance of winning, but also the cost of the bet, which reaches R$ 232,560.00 for the maximum number of selections.

Rollover and destination of unclaimed funds

If the prize is not won, it rolls over to the next draw. Amounts that are not claimed within 90 days are transferred to the National Treasury and invested in funds such as FIES.

With information from G1, Estadão.
